te: Draft report on the draft labour protection law, and a petition on the work permit project
se: The meeting noted that the draft report on the study of the draft Labour Protection Act (No. ..) B.E. .... has been made more concise, with a table comparing it with the existing law added, and will be considered again after hearing the employers' views. It also considered a petition asking for checks on the project contracting a private company to produce work permits and receive foreigners' applications
it: Draft report on the study of the draft Labour Protection Act (No. ..) B.E. ....
Petition asking for checks on the contract to produce work permits for foreigners

te: Department of Employment heard on jobs for older persons
se: The meeting heard the Department of Employment on its 2023–2026 plans for promoting employment and widening job opportunities for older persons, in preparation for an ageing society
it: Job placement for older persons

te: Approach set for the draft report on labour in an ageing society
se: The meeting considered its approach to the draft study report on approaches to labour development in an ageing society, to build a sustainable system of care for older workers amid demographic changes that affect the economy and the labour market
it: Approach to preparing the draft report on approaches to labour development in an ageing society

te: Department of Skill Development heard on developing older persons' skills
se: The meeting heard a representative of the Department of Skill Development on its vision and 6 main tasks, such as training, skill standards and the Skill Development Fund, as they relate to developing the skills of older workers
it: Tasks in developing the skills of older workers

se: The meeting heard a Deputy Director-General of the Department of Older Persons, who explained that Thailand has become a fully aged society, with older persons making up more than 20 per cent of the population, and that the 60–69 age group, about 7.8 million people, should be encouraged to have occupations
it: The Department of Older Persons' tasks on older persons

te: Ranong foreign workers report and results of proposals on older persons followed up
se: The meeting noted progress on the draft report on managing foreign workers, with Ranong Province as a case study, and resolved that it be printed for submission to the committee. It also noted what agencies have done in response to its recommendations on employing older persons
it: Working group studying approaches to managing foreign workers, Ranong Province
Results of action on the recommendations on employing older persons

te: NLDD report approved, and the report on employing older persons followed up
se: The meeting approved the draft report on the concept of a National Labour Development Digital Platform (NLDD) for submission, and noted the results of the study on widening employment opportunities and promoting the employment of older persons, resolving to follow up the results with agencies
it: Draft report on the concept of a National Labour Development Digital Platform (NLDD)
Report on widening employment opportunities and promoting the employment of older persons

te: Executive summary of the Ranong foreign workers report and the draft NLDD report approved
se: The meeting approved the executive summary of the study report on foreign workers in Ranong Province and the draft report on the concept of a National Labour Development Digital Platform (NLDD), resolving that the wording of the whole report be checked
it: Working group studying approaches to managing foreign workers, Ranong Province
Draft report on the concept of a National Labour Development Digital Platform (NLDD)

te: Summary of the study visit on clean energy and electric vehicles in Rayong
se: The meeting summarised its study visit to a clean energy research institute and an electric vehicle factory in Rayong Province, which gave information on the green economy, developing workers to meet the needs of industries of the future, and the skills Thai workers should develop
it: Summary of the study visit to Rayong Province

te: Results of the Skill Development Fund's operations considered
se: The meeting considered information on the results and financial reports of the Skill Development Fund, to which establishments with 100 or more employees must contribute, and made an observation asking the agency to explain its results and the value for money of its spending
it: Results of the Skill Development Fund's operations

te: Documents for Myanmar workers followed up, and a visit to Rayong and Chon Buri prepared
se: The meeting noted that the Department of Employment will put the proposal on identity documents for Myanmar workers to its executives and raise it at the bilateral meeting with Myanmar, and noted the schedule of the study visit to Rayong and Chon Buri Provinces on 3–4 September 2025
it: Petition on identity documents for Myanmar workers
Schedule of the study visit to Rayong and Chon Buri Provinces (3–4 September 2025)

te: Petition on identity certification for Myanmar workers considered
se: The meeting considered a petition asking the government to consider certifying the identity of Myanmar workers without a certificate of identity, as the petitioner stated that the documents are slow to issue. The Department of Employment explained that the documents are issued by the Myanmar authorities and that Thailand must certify individuals for security reasons
it: Petition asking for the identity of Myanmar workers to be certified without a certificate of identity

te: Information on shortages of seafarers noted
se: The meeting noted information that the global shipping industry may face a shortage of seafarers, while Thai training institutions do not yet produce enough personnel, and considered the problems and obstacles in developing Thai merchant marine careers
it: Approaches to developing seafarers for the merchant shipping industry

te: Framework set for the migrant workers working group, 2025–2026
se: The meeting considered the action plan of the working group studying approaches to solving problems in managing migrant workers for 2025–2026, consisting of discussions, studies of the law with central agencies, and gathering information in the field
it: Framework and approach of the working group on migrant workers

te: Findings on digital platforms for labour considered
se: The meeting considered the findings of the working group studying the use of digital platforms to manage labour across the whole system, such as the effects of artificial intelligence, the platform economy and remote work, and set the goal of developing a National Labour Development Digital Platform (NLDD) step by step from 2025
it: Working group studying the use of digital platforms to manage labour across the whole system

te: Department of Employment heard on labour demand
se: The meeting considered approaches to developing workers for the industries of the future (S-Curve and New S-Curve), based on industry needs, hearing the Department of Employment. In 2024, more than 8 hundred thousand vacancies were notified and more than 1.9 hundred thousand people were placed in jobs, with trends in demand for workers in the next-generation automotive industry and other target industries
it: Approaches to developing workers for the industries of the future (S-Curve and New S-Curve), based on industry needs
